name: Ashtasidhhi Industries Limited
summary: Ashtasidhhi Industries Ltd. operates as a Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC), primarily focusing on offering financial services, investment solutions, and leasing operations. The company is also extensively involved in the management, acquisition, development, and trading of various assets, encompassing both real estate and movable properties, along with associated rights and privileges. This firm was established on January 22, 1993, and its main office is situated in Ahmedabad, India.
